gaps: Private recipe/catalog capability and evidence claims are omitted together with discovery/interface metadata and proof pins. No public recipe or verified capability is selected.
Private operational methods, skills and examples remain excluded. The public initializer supports only the default scaffold; private purpose/recipe capabilities are not included.
Native classifier model assets and third-party distribution licenses are not bundled or qualified.
Publishing requires owner review of each selected file, license and destinations; this candidate does not authorize publication.

Private engine design documents and proof receipts are not shipped. Fresh public native/connector guides describe selected entrypoints and limits. Empty-portal smoke verification does not qualify authenticated app enrollment, native authority adoption, protected blobs or PGlite restoration.

Host jobs execute the selected file-authority build/recording pipeline in a private clone. Native capture and review remain separate; no cloud deployment, live provider qualification or automated commit-back is included.

Storage admission is partial and route-limited; aggregate capacity remains unavailable. Protected App attachments require the selected per-record provider route and current host/policy checks. Native record bodies, history and metadata are outside the attachment envelope. The local installer stages only an exact reviewed App bundle as a disabled draft; it does not enroll or activate Apps or grant user access. Trusted-host protected snapshot capture is selected only for its declared retained-content route and checks; it does not provide restore or cutover. Generic App replacement, general retention deletion, restore/cutover and aggregate capacity remain unsupported or refuse when guarantees are absent. See docs/storage-admission.md.

The selected v10 backup route supports one host-registered local SQLite authority and local-files destination for supported no-blob or database-blob snapshots. Adopted/protected sources, external filesystem blobs, remote destinations, multi-store atomicity and general PGlite restore are unsupported or refuse. This route is not live-cloud or public acceptance evidence.

Structured MCP citation sources are bundled for source-closure, but this edition's public brain_mcp:create_application() factory leaves structured_citations disabled and does not configure a citation origin. The citation result contract and route remain unadvertised and unqualified here; do not enable the constructor option or advertise structured results until the consumer path and result variants are selected and qualified.

CMS context navigation, explicit owning-writer selection, registered JSON controls and the versioned ontology source-intent/proposal engine are selected as optional code. They require an explicitly configured current host, policy, owner/writer bindings and source Registry; the public empty scaffold does not enroll a writer, mount these panels automatically or grant any record/source mutation.

CMS recipe/skill guidance projection code is selected, but no private catalog, practices/semantic-authoring.json task instructions, task-reference documents, field-hint instance or precomputed published guidance artifact is distributed. An operator must supply an independently reviewed compatible catalog/task/schema declaration set and explicitly review/pin its bounded projection before a CMS can display it. Without those inputs, recipe/skill guidance is unavailable; navigation/writer selection and the separate ontology source handoff do not infer a recipe capability.

Native collection browsing is optional code for an explicitly selected v11 SQLite operations host and v13 requests/results. No host, actor grant, writer registration or private catalog is included. Current page visibility and native revision checks do not establish a multi-request transaction or arbitrary database/filesystem tamper immunity. See docs/native-collection-browser.md.

Identifier migration selects current operator-owned plain JSON artifacts through preview, exact reviewed plan and private resumable publication. Supported local metadata/filesystem profiles must be established independently; native records, frozen schemas/catalogs, signed history and unsupported metadata refuse. No build automatically runs these tools, and legacy identifier readers remain. See docs/identifier-migration.md.

The selected cooperative native administration fences and conservative private-residue checks do not qualify a complete brain-wide quota. Unknown writer effects and retained debt are not silently deleted or released; aggregateCapacity.available remains false.
